english.title: Commissioner / investigating Commissioner / employee / member of equality committee disclose information
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[being a Commissioner of]_
(B)_[having been a Commissioner of]_
(C)_[being an Investigating Commissioner of]_
(D)_[having been an Investigating Commissioner of]_
(E)_[being an employee of]
(F)_[having been an employee of]_
(G)_[being a member of a committee established by]_
(H)_[having been a member of a committee established by]_

the Commission for Equality and Human Rights, disclosed information to which section 6 of the Equality Act 2006 applied, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) when not authorised to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to section 6(1) and (6) of the Equality Act 2006.
